July 30, 2019 — eleven days before the death. An Oxford mathematician wrote to Jeffrey Epstein inside the MCC with a lifeline: donate $5 million to Morgan State University — a historically Black college — to endow "the Jeffrey Epstein Chair for the Promotion of Women in Mathematics." His pitch, in writing: it would "show the world you are not a pariah and may help you avoid a conviction like Bill Cosby." EFTA00035613, via the GAH visual evidence index. Full document: grokarchivehub.com/archive/EFTA00035613 (link in bio).

The investigation into the death had its own paperwork. This is the waiver MCC staff signed before the DOJ's Inspector General interviewed them — acknowledging the interview was voluntary and any statement could be used as evidence, with the subject hand-written on the form itself: the investigation into Jeffrey Epstein and employee misconduct at the MCC. This one was signed August 21, 2019, at SDNY. EFTA00035773, via the GAH visual evidence index. Full document: grokarchivehub.com/archive/EFTA00035773 (link in bio).

You wanted the zoom-in. After the SDNY floor plan — the cell-block diagram with Epstein's cell marked in red.
